news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Emeka Egbuka dealing with sprained toe, expected to be ready for Week 1
news.desc: Emeka Egbuka has a sprained toe, but he is expected to be good to go for Week 1.
news.impact: Egbuka underwent more testing on his injured toe and a specialist diagnosed him with a sprained toe after he limped off the field during the joint practice at the Jets' facility.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Josh Jacobs (groin) could return next week
news.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs could return to practice next week.
news.impact: LaFleur clarified that it wouldn't be till later in the week. Jacobs has been absent from practice due to a groin injury.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Nazeeh Johnson suspended six games by NFL
news.desc: The NFL has suspended Titans CB Nazeeh Johnson six regular season games for performance-enhancing substance policy violation.
news.impact: Johnson can still participate in all preseason activities. He will be eligible for reinstatement on October 19.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Dorance Armstrong Jr. suspended for the season opener
news.desc: The NFL has suspended DE Dorance Armstrong Jr. for the season opener.
news.impact: Armstrong is still eligible to participate in all preseason activities. He'll be eligible for reinstatement on September 14.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Phidarian Mathis suspended three games
news.desc: Bills DT Phidarian Mathis has been suspended for three games for violating the NFL's Substances of Abuse Policy.
news.impact: Mathis is still eligible to participate in preseason practices and games. He'll be eligible to return September 28.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Brandon George signs with Eagles
news.desc: The Eagles signed LB Brandon George.
news.impact: George spent last season on injured reserve with the Chiefs. He will compete for a depth role in the Eagles linebacker room.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: James Pearce Jr. suspended eight games by NFL
news.desc: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. is being suspended eight regular-season games for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.
news.impact: Pearce was arrested in February after a domestic dispute. He will miss the first eight games of the season.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Kurtis Rourke (ribs) released from hospital
news.desc: Kurtis Rourke was released from a local hospital Thursday night.
news.impact: Rourke left Thursday's preseason game against the Titans in the first half. He was having trouble breathing, head coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game. The initial X-rays he underwent did not show a broken rib.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Carson Beck not dealing with serious rib injury
news.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said he has 'no concern' over the rib injury that Carson Beck is dealing with.
news.impact: The injury kept Beck out of Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders. He should be good to go for next week's preseason game.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Kirk Cousins: Starting job is 'his to lose' per HC Klint Kubiak
news.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said "it's his job to lose" when asked about Kirk Cousins' status as QB1 following Thursday's preseason game.
news.impact: Cousins played on the opening drive on Thursday, which resulted in a touchdown pass to Michael Mayer. He remains highly likely to open the season as the starter for Las Vegas.
